items.title: When It Comes to Ticketing Legislation, Price Caps Get All the Attention. But In State Legislatures Nationwide, Some Very Different Ticketing Battles Are Raging
items.summary: Despite heroic efforts, California legislators recently failed to follow Maine, Vermont, and Washington, DC, in passing a 10% resale price cap. But it’s not just California: ambitious price-cap bills simply haven’t succeeded in bigger markets, while a very different legislative trajectory has emerged. And just like that, the ‘California Fans First Act’ (AB 1720) died […]
